1x1.name: 1X1
1x1.short: A minimalist puzzle game built around simple logic.
1x1.long: 1X1 is a minimalist puzzle experience where players solve logical challenges using a simple grid system. The gameplay focuses on clarity and pure puzzle mechanics without unnecessary distractions.
1x1.head: ../GameAsset/1X1/1x1_head.jpg

4x4.name: 4X4
4x4.short: A grid-based puzzle game set in a 4x4 board.
4x4.long: 4X4 challenges players to solve puzzles within a limited 4x4 grid. Each level requires careful thinking and pattern recognition to reach the correct solution.
4x4.head: ../GameAsset/4X4/4X4_head.jpg

emoji-bomb.name: Emoji Bomb
emoji-bomb.short: Avoid dangerous emoji bombs in this fast-paced arcade game.
emoji-bomb.long: Emoji Bomb is a fast-paced arcade game where players must dodge exploding emojis while trying to survive as long as possible. Quick reflexes and focus are essential.
emoji-bomb.head: ../GameAsset/EMOJI BOMB/EMOJI BOMB_head.jpg

on-your-notebook.name: On Your Notebook
on-your-notebook.short: A casual game set inside a notebook world.
on-your-notebook.long: On Your Notebook takes place on the pages of a notebook where drawings come to life. The game offers a light and relaxing experience with simple mechanics and playful visuals.
on-your-notebook.head: ../GameAsset/On Your Notebook/On Your Notebook.jpg
